# Straconis Software Dev Nexus Launcher 0.4.0-alpha

- Removes the S3D Labs image and link from the footer.
- Adds a wide S3D Labs banner to its Supported Projects tile using its WordPress Media Library URL, with a bundled fallback.
- Adds an optional Tile banner URL to the desktop admin editor for tools and supported projects.
- Adds banner persistence to the Rust broker and Nexus WordPress Service, including the WordPress admin form and catalog import/export.
- Downloads PNG/JPEG banners in the background and crops them to 3:1. Failed downloads preserve the card controls, and Refresh retries them.
- Preserves banners when an older desktop client saves other project details.

## Downloads

- Windows per-user installer: `nexus-launcher-setup-0.4.0-alpha-windows-x86_64.exe`
- Windows portable ZIP: `nexus-launcher-windows-x86_64.zip`
- Linux x86_64: `nexus-launcher-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
- Checksums: `SHA256SUMS.txt`

Upload banner images through WordPress Media Library, copy their File URL, and paste it into Tile banner in the admin editor. Use a direct HTTPS PNG or JPEG URL, up to 4 MiB and 4096 pixels per side. A wide 3:1 image works best. Clear the field to restore the default appearance.

Update Nexus WordPress Service to 0.2.0 or the Rust broker to 0.4.0-alpha to enable custom-banner persistence. The desktop installer packages the launcher.

Users on 0.3.1-alpha or 0.3.2-alpha can use UPDATE LAUNCHER. Users on 0.3.0-alpha need one manual download. Windows binaries are unsigned. macOS packages are unavailable. This is an alpha release.
